TERMS, SAFETY, EARNINGS & PRIVACY POLICY
Effective for Hotel Partners registered with JIIFIT LLP
📋 Introduction

Please read the following terms carefully before completing your Hotel Partner registration. By accepting these terms, the Hotel Partner agrees to cooperate with JIIFIT LLP for safe, professional and smooth delivery of wellness services at the hotel.
1. Hotel Partner Eligibility & Verification

• The Hotel Partner confirms that all information and documents submitted during registration are genuine, accurate and up to date.

• JIIFIT LLP may verify the hotel, business details, authorized representative, contact information, room information and other relevant details before approving the partnership.

• JIIFIT LLP reserves the right to approve, suspend or reject a Hotel Partner registration based on verification, operational, safety, compliance or business requirements.
2. Services Available Through JIIFIT
The Hotel Partner may receive or place bookings for the following services through the JIIFIT Expert App:
✓ Massage at Hotel
✓ Yoga at Hotel
✓ Ayurveda at Hotel
✓ Personal Trainer at Hotel
Only services made available by JIIFIT through the platform may be offered under this partnership.
3. Professional Safety & Gender Matching Policy
For Massage and Ayurveda services, JIIFIT will generally assign a same-gender professional:
→ Male client → Male professional
→ Female client → Female professional

For Yoga and Personal Trainer services, JIIFIT may assign a male or female professional, depending on professional availability, client requirements, booking circumstances and operational considerations.\n\nProfessional allocation is subject to availability and JIIFIT's safety and operational policies.
⚠️ 4. Zero-Tolerance Policy for Misconduct

JIIFIT LLP follows a zero-tolerance approach towards sexual misconduct, harassment, inappropriate behaviour, threats, intimidation, fraud or any other unacceptable conduct towards JIIFIT professionals.\n\nIf a client behaves inappropriately or makes a professional feel unsafe, the Hotel Partner must cooperate with JIIFIT immediately.
This includes, but is not limited to:
• Sexual or inappropriate behaviour
• Unwanted physical contact
• Sexual comments, requests or advances
• Harassment or intimidation
• Threatening behaviour
• Abusive language
• Fraudulent activity
• Deliberate misuse of the service
• Any behaviour that creates an unsafe working environment

JIIFIT may suspend or permanently restrict the client's ability to make future bookings and may take other appropriate action.\n\nWhere an incident may constitute a criminal offence, JIIFIT LLP may cooperate with the Hotel Partner, law-enforcement authorities or other competent government authorities and provide relevant information or evidence as permitted or required by applicable Indian law.
5. Hotel's Responsibility During a Safety Incident
If any JIIFIT professional reports a safety concern or misconduct at the hotel, the Hotel Partner should:
1. Provide reasonable assistance to the professional.
2. Coordinate promptly with JIIFIT's support/management team.
3. Preserve relevant CCTV footage, booking records or other evidence where legally permissible and applicable.
4. Take reasonable steps to prevent escalation of the incident.
5. Cooperate with JIIFIT and competent authorities where required.
The Hotel Partner must not conceal, manipulate or destroy relevant information relating to a serious incident.
6. Client Fraud & Misuse

If JIIFIT or the Hotel Partner identifies a client involved in fraudulent bookings, payment fraud, identity misuse, repeated intentional cancellations, abusive conduct or other misuse of the platform, JIIFIT may take appropriate action.\n\nSuch action may include:
• Booking cancellation
• Restriction or suspension of the client's account
• Refusal of future bookings
• Recovery of applicable charges
• Internal investigation
• Cooperation with the Hotel Partner
• Reporting to law-enforcement or competent authorities where appropriate or legally required
💰 7. Hotel Partner Earning – ₹500 Per Eligible Booking

The Hotel Partner will receive a fixed ₹500 earning for every eligible completed booking under the Hotel Partnership program.

An earning becomes payable only when the booking qualifies as an eligible completed booking under JIIFIT's applicable booking and payment rules.

Cancelled, fraudulent, disputed, incomplete or otherwise ineligible bookings will not qualify for the ₹500 partner earning.
💳 8. Weekly Withdrawal Policy
Hotel Partner earnings can be withdrawn according to the following rules:
• The Hotel Partner can make one withdrawal every 7 days.
• The Hotel Partner may choose any day to make the withdrawal.
• After a withdrawal is completed, the next withdrawal option will become available 7 days later.
• There is no minimum withdrawal balance requirement.
• The Hotel Partner may withdraw the entire available eligible balance in the account.
Example: If a Hotel Partner withdraws on Monday, the next withdrawal option will become available after 7 days, on the following Monday.
❌ 9. Client Cancellation & Cancellation Fee

If a client repeatedly books a service and subsequently cancels in a manner that causes a JIIFIT professional to travel to the location and lose working time, JIIFIT may apply the applicable cancellation fee to the client.\n\nThe purpose of the cancellation fee is to compensate for the professional's:
• Travel time
• Lost working time
• Availability blocked for the booking
• Other reasonable operational loss
Where a cancellation fee is applicable under JIIFIT's policy, the collected cancellation amount will be paid to the concerned JIIFIT professional, subject to the applicable cancellation policy.
⚠️ Important Hotel Partner Rule

The Hotel Partner will not receive any share of the cancellation fee. The applicable cancellation compensation is intended for the JIIFIT professional whose time and travel were affected by the cancellation.
10. Booking & Room Information
The Hotel Partner is responsible for providing accurate room numbers and relevant booking information through the JIIFIT Expert App.
11. Professional Conduct & Hotel Cooperation
The Hotel Partner agrees to maintain a safe and professional environment for JIIFIT professionals.
12. Privacy & Confidentiality

Information collected during Hotel Partner registration may be used for onboarding, verification, booking management, payment processing, safety and legal compliance. JIIFIT LLP will handle personal and business information in accordance with its applicable Privacy Policy and applicable laws.
13. No Unauthorized Recording or Disclosure

The Hotel Partner must not intentionally record, photograph, publish or distribute private service-related interactions without appropriate authorization, except where required or permitted by applicable law.
14. Policy Violations

JIIFIT LLP may temporarily suspend, restrict or terminate a Hotel Partner account if there is fraud, false registration, misuse of the app, unsafe conduct, unauthorized financial activity or any conduct that materially threatens the safety, reputation or operation of the JIIFIT platform.
15. Policy Updates

JIIFIT LLP may modify its booking, earning, withdrawal, safety, privacy or operational policies from time to time. Updated policies may be communicated through the JIIFIT Expert App, registered contact information or other official communication channels.
16. Acceptance & Declaration
I have read, understood and agree to the Hotel Partner Registration Terms, Safety Policy, Earning & Withdrawal Policy, Cancellation Policy and Privacy Policy of JIIFIT LLP.

I confirm that the information provided during registration is true and accurate and that I am authorized to represent the hotel/business. I agree to cooperate with JIIFIT LLP in maintaining a safe, professional and respectful environment for customers and JIIFIT professionals, including Massage Professionals, Yoga Experts, Ayurveda Professionals and Personal Trainers.

I understand that JIIFIT maintains a zero-tolerance approach towards fraud, harassment, sexual misconduct, threats and other serious inappropriate behaviour, and I agree to cooperate with JIIFIT and competent authorities whenever required under applicable law.

I also understand that the Hotel Partner earns ₹500 for each eligible completed booking, may withdraw the available eligible balance once every 7 days with no minimum withdrawal requirement, and will not receive any share of applicable client cancellation fees paid to the concerned professional.
